records.name: Thirteen Colonies Amateur Radio Association
records.notes: The website is for the annual 13 Colonies Special Event, an on-air amateur radio operating event held July 1 to 7, 2026. It is an event, not a group: the page lists no membership, meetings, staff contact or Philadelphia address. The IRS name is the association's legal name and a link between the event and this IRS entity is not confirmed. The IRS address (3341 Sheffield Ave) is in Northeast Philadelphia, so a local ham club may exist and is worth a later check.

records.name: Virginia Association of Liberians in the Americas
records.notes: The website field held the word PERSONAL, not a web address, so no website was read. One of the two searches found no page for an organization by this name. The closest hit, the Union of Liberian Associations in the Americas, is a separate, Washington DC based umbrella group and was not matched to this record. IRS address 4555 Loring St (19136). Needs an IRS side or local check before it can be classified.

records.name: 12 Plus
records.summary: A college and career readiness nonprofit that works inside partner Philadelphia high schools, helping students plan for college and jobs after 12th grade.
records.what_you_do: Volunteers can sit on panels at the yearly career and higher education fairs, act as mock interview partners, or present at information sessions. Working professionals can also apply to the 10-month Fellows program, which places fellows full time in school-based centers.

schedule.text: No set weekly schedule for volunteers. The career and higher education fairs run once a year at the group's centers, and volunteers are asked to take on at least one opportunity a year.

cost.text: The page lists no fee for volunteers. It asks for donations.

first_step.how: Email info@12plus.org to say which role you would like, such as a career fair panelist or a mock interview partner. There is no form to fill out.
first_step.basis: Volunteer roles are listed publicly with a clear email contact and no minimum commitment, though no training is described.

records.notes: Status is active on the strength of the 2026 to 2027 Fellows call on the fellowship page. That page gives no month, so last_sign_of_life is left out. The homepage impact figures are from the Class of 2025. Fellows apply through an external job posting, and pay and the deadline are not stated. IRS name and the group's name match.

records.name: Auxilium Payee Services
records.notes: A representative payee, bill-payment and money-management service. The page lists no community program, class, group or volunteer role, and fees are not published. The site describes it as a 501(c)(3). Hidden as a service business with no community program. Worth a review if the site is missing a public program.

records.name: By My Side Parenting
records.summary: A parenting group in Fishtown that runs open playgroups, so families with babies and young children can play, learn and meet other parents.
records.what_you_do: Bring your little one to the Monday baby group or the Wednesday and Friday morning playgroup to play and talk with other families. A small donation is suggested.

schedule.text: Baby Group on Mondays, 12 to 1 pm. All-ages Morning Playgroup on Wednesdays and Fridays, 10 to 11:30 am.

locations.label: Playgroup space in the back building of Atonement Lutheran Church

cost.text: A $5 donation is suggested for the morning playgroup. The page does not say whether the baby group has a fee.

first_step.how: Come to the Wednesday or Friday morning playgroup at 10 am. Use the alley entrance with the white doors and go up the stairs to the playgroup space.
first_step.basis: Programs are open to all on posted weekly times, and the page describes no sign-up step.

records.notes: Legal name By My Side, Ltd. Status is probably active: the site works but shows no dated events. Its only years are 2007 (founding) and a 2023 footer, which are not evidence. No email or phone is published. The address comes from the group's Where We Are page, which places the playgroup in the back building of Atonement Lutheran Church. Atonement's own site was checked for the address only.

records.name: Common Cents
records.summary: A student-facing financial education group that runs money workshops and gives members chances to teach financial literacy at local high schools.
records.what_you_do: Members can take part in financial education events and workshops, and volunteer to teach financial literacy at local high schools. The site invites students to join to meet peers and give back.

first_step.how: If you are a student, use the Join Us button on commoncents.org. Otherwise email hello@commoncents.org to ask about workshops or high school teaching.
first_step.basis: Membership is described for students, and the site does not explain the join process.

records.notes: Legal name Common Cents Collaborative. The homepage is a financial education blog with no dated events; its only year is a 2025 footer, which is not evidence. Philadelphia is not named on the homepage. The Philadelphia link rests on the IRS address (533 E Girard Ave, a mailing address), the Penn student section and the high school teaching. The /about page returned 404. Whether the IRS entity is this website is not confirmed. Review before publishing.

records.name: Esteem Girls
records.summary: A nonprofit that runs hands-on STEM activities for girls in grades 3 to 8, both after school and on Saturdays.
records.what_you_do: Girls take part in hands-on science, technology, engineering and math activities with program staff, on weekday afternoons after school and on second Saturdays. Some afterschool pickups are offered from select schools.

schedule.text: STEM Afterschool runs Monday to Friday from school dismissal to 6 pm during the 2026 to 2027 school year. STEM Saturday meets on second Saturdays, 10 am to 12 pm, in the same school year.

cost.text: Families who qualify for ELRC or CCIS childcare assistance pay $0. The page lists no other tuition.

first_step.how: Fill out the STEM Afterschool or STEM Saturday interest form linked from esteemgirls.org/programs.
first_step.basis: Enrollment for grades 3 to 8 is open through a public interest form, and qualifying families pay $0.

records.notes: IRS legal name Esteem Girls Inc. The site gives no email or phone, only a contact form. A six week summer institute for Black and Brown girls is announced for 2027 with no dates yet. Afterschool pickups are offered from William McKinley, Julia de Burgos, Conwell Middle School, Sankofa Freedom Academy and Mariana Bracetti Academy.

records.name: Fishtown Playschool
records.summary: A cooperatively run playschool in Fishtown where young children learn through play, using ideas from Reggio Emilia, emergent curriculum and Montessori.
records.what_you_do: Children attend classes at the playschool and learn through play. Families apply online, and tours are open only to families who have applied.

cost.text: A $30 application fee per family. Tuition is not published.

first_step.how: Complete the online application and pay the $30 family fee at jovial.org/fishtown/register, the link from the playschool's apply page.
first_step.basis: A submitted application and a fee come before a family can see the school, and classes fill on a first come basis.

records.notes: The site does not state an age range. Tuition and class times are not published, so no schedule is given. There are no dated news items or enrollment dates; status is probably active as a working site. No preschool tag exists in the vocabulary, so parent_playgroups is the closest fit for a cooperative early childhood school.

records.name: VETMOTO
records.summary: A nonprofit motorcycle shop where veterans and at-risk young people learn engine repair and trade skills, with basic skills classes in resume writing and leadership.
records.what_you_do: Members learn introductory trade skills and engine repair and take basic skills classes. Volunteers help with shop maintenance and facility projects at the VetMotoShop, and mentors support members.

cost.text: No participation fee is listed. The group asks for donations.

first_step.how: Call (215) 586-3494 or use the contact form on vetmoto.org to ask about volunteer work at the VetMotoShop, or visit the shop to help on a project.
first_step.basis: The site invites the public to visit the shop and volunteer on a project, lists a phone number and a contact form, and describes no application.

records.notes: IRS legal name Veterans Motorcycle Program. The IRS record gives 2214 Sepviva Street; the group's own contact page gives 2212 Sepviva Street, which is used here. No class dates or events are published, and the only year is a 2026 footer, so status is probably active. Eligibility is not formally stated: the page names veterans and at-risk Philadelphia youth as its focus groups.

records.name: MAEBL
records.notes: MAEBL (Meeting for Advanced Electron Beam Lithography) is a professional community for people who use electron beam lithography tools. The only Philadelphia link is the IRS address, 1212 E Susquehanna Ave. Registration runs through an outside ticketing page, which was not read (lead only).

IRS address 2329 S 17th St (19145). Not verified; needs a check of the IRS record or a local contact.

records.name: A.S. Jenks Home and School Association
records.summary: Parents, guardians and teachers at A.S. Jenks Elementary who run school events and fundraising and show appreciation for staff.
records.what_you_do: Members attend the general meetings, held on Zoom, and help with school events such as the book fair, picture day and sales, plus fundraising.

schedule.text: General meetings held on Zoom from 7 to 8 pm, about every two months. Dates posted on the site: Nov 12, 2026; Jan 14, 2027; Mar 11, 2027; May 6, 2027.

cost.text: The page lists no dues. Its JOIN page links to a plans and pricing page, which was not read.

first_step.how: Email asjenkshsa@gmail.com or call (267) 225-5028 to ask for the Zoom link to the next general meeting, Nov 12, 2026 at 7 pm.
first_step.basis: The group welcomes parents, guardians and teachers and lists a phone and email, but the join steps and any membership plan sit on a page I did not read.

records.notes: Serves one school, so the group is for families at A.S. Jenks Elementary. Our rules hide booster clubs for one school. This is a home and school association open to school families with public meeting dates, which is a close call, so it is published with open_to set to parents. Flagged for owner review. Officers are named on the site; no names are recorded here.

Jenks Home and School Association is a close call under the one-school rule, flagged for review. Esteem Girls, 12 Plus, Fishtown Playschool and VETMOTO join pages were read. No rate limiting seen. Ran out of search budget: yes. Verdict counts: publish 12 (7 with full records, 5 held back as unknown), hide 1, not_a_group 1, out_of_area 1.
